How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Survived a tornado
I highly recommend these glasses. I was camping when severe weather started. They were on my head when all this went down. Next thing you know, I'm trapped between a canopy and my car once the winds started. It was pure craziness. A tornado touched down about 2 miles from us. The next day, my husband pulled the glasses out of the ground. I completely forgot about them, honestly. Both sides were stuck in the dirt. The lens popped out a little and the one side got a little bent. However, these pictures are after it was all said and done. Been wearing them since we got back earlier this week and I have no problem with them. It's also kinda cool because they stick out the side of your face far enough and it kinda acts as your own rear view mirrors. If I could give higher than 5 stars, I 100% would.

    Great all around sunglasses (gentle monster HER dupe)
    Reviewed in the United States on July 19, 2023
    Color: Black/Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I normally don't write reviews but I must give credit where credit is due. These are the perfect dupe for the Gentle Monster HER sunglasses that you've seen everywhere in Kdramas and below deck sailing. I have a big, round, and semi-flat face so not many sunglasses fit/look great on me but these ones do! It's a bit oversized but that's exactly what I'm looking for. It fits nice on my low bridge nose and also does not touch my cheeks. The quality and feel is a bit cheap but it LOOKS high quality so that's why I don't mind at all. And the price point makes it an absolute STEAL! And it doesn't make me feel as guilty if it were to scratch it or lose it rather than spending $200 for the GM one. Overall SUPER happy with my purchase.

    A great alternative to Gentle Monster sunglasses! I have been looking for a cheapest, dupe version of Gentle Monster glasses because Gentle Monster is one of the my favorite sunglasses brand, worn by so many celebrities. I really like this classic design because it’s simple, versatile, and stylish. I have also been struggling to find a pair that would complement my face, so I’m giving this a try. My first initial thought of this sunglasses is that I was not expect to be this big (well yeah it’s oversized), like the lens covered half of my face with it! The fitting is great, it perfectly complements my round face thank goodness, and it doesn’t slip when shaking my head or tilting my head down! I haven’t using it under the sun, so I have no comment about how much sun blockage can the glasses handle in comparison to a polarized sunglasses. But overall, I’m happy with this purchase! If you want to find a sunglasses under budget, but wanted to look bougie or a fashion icon, then I recommend this!
